scope_rule: This work upgrades the natural Block -> Logic Group -> KP layer only. It does not create or approve A3 system.json, a SuperSystem owner, learner readiness, or any S/K/L/P/R/E/U gate for the whole urinary System.

historical_substrate.system_guide: content/xizong/knowledge/system-guides/西综泌尿系统_System_Guide_v1_完整导学_认知依赖与学习顺序.md
historical_substrate.rule: Existing A3 files preserve useful medical/source work and stable identities, but their historical '最终执行版' labels are not acceptance evidence under the Current learning philosophy. Each Block must be re-read and explicitly upgraded before it may be treated as Current learner-facing Knowledge.

upgrade_contract.identity: Preserve stable block_id and KP identity unless an explicit semantic defect requires a reviewed split/merge/renumber. Reordering for causal learner order does not itself authorize identity replacement.
upgrade_contract.lecture_first: First learning is Framework orientation -> continuous Lecture/source contact -> Logic Group/KP active Recall -> Block compression. Historical instructions that ask an unlearned learner to recall KP content before Lecture must be removed or superseded.
upgrade_contract.logic_group: A Logic Group is one continuous mechanism/judgment chain that can be learned and closed as a unit; it is not an arbitrary equal-sized slice or a second medical-Core owner.
upgrade_contract.kp_lossless: The union of canonical KPs must preserve the learning value of the bound Lecture/source without turning KianOS into a second textbook. Stable mechanisms, relations, boundaries, high-value precision and necessary examples must not silently disappear.
upgrade_contract.timing: Current Core, Recall, Reserve, Connection Hook and Deferred content must be separated by learning timing. Future-owner material may orient or connect but must not seize first-pass working memory.
upgrade_contract.precision: Precision is an accuracy attribute, not a demand that every number/drug/threshold become stable on first exposure.
upgrade_contract.source_safety: Source conflicts, uncertain claims and unsupported expansions must be explicit and adjudicated before the affected medical Core can pass. A historical Study wording is not automatically learner-canonical when it conflicts with reliable medical truth.
upgrade_contract.runtime_boundary: Do not redesign Projection/Runtime per Block during this content pass. A1/A2 provide the runtime reference; A3 may expose genuine system-specific needs later.

batch_plan.theme: normal renal physiology foundation: map/clearance -> filtration -> segmental transport/diuretics -> hormonal control/concentration
water-electrolyte-acid-base -> urine evidence -> AKI/CKD/dialysis -> bacterial UTI
glomerular immune mechanism -> nephritic branch -> nephrotic branch

shared_findings: The four historical Blocks already carry stable block_id/KP identities and substantial source-bound medical Core; the upgrade should preserve good Core rather than rewrite for style.

B1/B2 still encode the older first-pass behavior 'Framework -> KP prompt/closed-book recovery' before continuous Lecture learning. This conflicts with Current Lecture-first policy and must be reconstructed.

B3/B4 already state a Lecture-first sequence and have much clearer Primary/Recall/Defer boundaries, so their likely upgrade path is semantic verification plus Logic Group reconstruction rather than wholesale prose replacement.

All four Blocks currently mix learner guidance, backend/audit language and long detailed Core in one Markdown. Learner-facing projection concerns will be handled later; this batch judges whether the canonical medical/learning asset itself is sound.

urinary-b01.first_pass_defect: Historical usage asks the learner to enter KP closed-book recovery immediately after Framework instead of completing the bound Lecture first.
strengths_to_preserve: renal endocrine and juxtaglomerular apparatus interfaces
micturition reflex as a later urologic-surgery prerequisite
timing_risks: Free-water clearance is introduced before the concentration/dilution engine is formally learned; keep it as measurement language only and prevent premature mechanism expansion.
SGLT2/high-protein hyperfiltration and ACEI/ARB cases must remain mechanism calibration, not expand into full diabetes/CKD/cardiovascular treatment owners.
Micturition is valid Primary here only as normal physiology; B12 owns disease application.
